{{TierBar}}


'''Pure Parasites''' are a Tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. This Tier is near the top of their Hierarchy and contains 7 Mobs. 

Pure Parasites are likely some of the most dangerous Parasites the Player will encounter, right behind [[Preeminent Parasites|Preeminent]]. If a player manages to kill all of them at least once, it grants them the {{AdvancementLink|Pure}}.

== ''Shared Aspects and Capabilities'' ==

=== Spawning ===
*Spawn naturally from [[Ubiquitous Development]] Level 4 and higher (excl. Light Bombers); 
**Light Bombers spawn naturally from [[Evolution Phases#Phase 8|Phase 8]] onwards.
*Spawned by [[Stage III Beckon|Stage III Beckons]];
*Spawned inside the [[Parasite Biome]].

=== Weakness ===
*Like all Parasites, Pures present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled);
*Some of the Pure Parasites present either a [[Adaptation System#Trivia|Weak Point]] or [[Adaptation System#Neutralization|Tendrils]]:
**When [[Adaptation System#Trivia|Weak Points]] are hit, the damage inflicted to the Parasite is tripled. This also inflicts the [[Bleeding]] Effect to the Parasite;
**When [[Adaptation System#Neutralization|Tendrils]] are hit enough times, they'll be cut off, resetting the Parasites' [[Adaptation System|Adaptation]]. This also inflicts the [[Bleeding]] and [[Rage]] Effects.

=== Combat Capabilities ===
*All Pure Parasites but the Grunt can summon [[Seizer|Seizers]] to support them;
*All Pure Parasites but the Grunt can use personal [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]] to teleport;
More to be added...

=== Post-Death ===
*After dying, all Pures have a chance to explode, releasing a Potion Cloud which inflicts the Poison and [[Call Of The Hive]] Effects. They will also leave behind [[Remains|Pure Remains]];
*After dying, all Pures have a chance to activate the [[Reinforcement System]].
